g.text: 1. Rev C: plate 0.87 mm; with the 0.13 mm adhesive sheet the PCB underside is at z = 1.0.
2. Ball feet: the print cannot hold a 0.1 mm protrusion. Clamp the plate flat on a gauge plate with three reamed
Ø0.6 holes, drop the balls in (each seats on the rim of its hole, 0.1 proud), pot them from this
side, cure. At lamination the sheet holes are filled with epoxy as well (README assembly steps 2 and 10).
3. The top face is the bonding face for the adhesive sheet and the seal land (r 21.35 to 21.75, joint
0.33 mm). Plain edge: no notch crosses the seal land. The plate is registered to the PCB in the
lamination jig (D outline against the PCB locating holes), not by a key in the tub (D07).
4. One slot for the seven pads (webs between Ø2.2 holes would be 0.34 mm).
5. No wall below 0.8 mm (check 5). Dyed, NOT vapor smoothed (hidden part, three bonding faces).
6. Flatness, free state on a surface plate: 0.3 mm maximum; flatten under weight if exceeded.
Thickness 0.87 +-0.05 (0.82 to 0.92 accepted); ream the three foot holes to Ø1.15.
